name: two-ways
title: One Pull Request, Two Dialects
kicker: Pull request 501, just before the merge
html:
One Pull Request, Two Dialects

HAL Schema Forms: _forms

offered as: application/hal+json
'_forms: scm:merge':
  title: Merge
  description: Merge the pull request into its base branch.
  _links:
    target:
      href: /repos/acme/web/pulls/501/actions/merge
  method: PUT
  contentType: application/json
  hr:integrity: sha256-sGUdrPfHMytyy3aRS+Ep6H4votEj67pweUa6ioBBwF8=
  schema:
    required:
      - method
    properties:
      commit_message:
        description: Extra detail to append to automatic commit message.
        title: Commit message
        type: string
      commit_title:
        description: Title for the automatic commit message.
        title: Commit title
        type: string
      method:
        description: The merge method to use.
        enum:
          - merge
          - squash
          - rebase
        title: Merge method
        type: string
ARTIE sent:
  method: PUT
  path: /repos/acme/web/pulls/501/actions/merge
  body:
    method: squash
answered: 200

HAL-FORMS: _templates

offered as: application/prs.hal-forms+json
'_templates: scm:merge':
  title: Merge
  method: PUT
  contentType: application/json
  target: /repos/acme/web/pulls/501/actions/merge
  properties:
    - name: method
      prompt: Merge method
      required: true
      type: text
      options:
        inline:
          - merge
          - squash
          - rebase
        minItems: 1
        maxItems: 1
    - name: commit_title
      prompt: Commit title
      required: false
      type: text
    - name: commit_message
      prompt: Commit message
      required: false
      type: text
ARTIE sent:
  method: PUT
  path: /repos/acme/web/pulls/501/actions/merge
  body:
    method: squash
answered: 200

Two stills. Read as HEART, this slide links a script that turns one into the other (deck:code).

Same name, same method, same address, and the same act sent: {method: squash}.
say: Here's pull request 501, a moment before the merge, as each dialect offers it. HAL Schema Forms puts the act under _forms, with a JSON Schema for its fields and a hash of the whole form. HAL-FORMS puts it under _templates, with a list of properties, each an HTML input type. Watch what carries over: the name, scm:merge; the method, PUT; and the pull request's own address. And what ARTIE sends is the same in both: method squash. Same relation, same act, two shapes.
